_note: OBSERVED sources genuinely encountered during this session's Phase-8/9.5 work on the Airbnb pocket. Each source lists the problem(s) it evidences. No frequency/demand invented; strength is per-source. Basis observed = the source itself was seen; it is NOT a claim about how many people are affected.

sources.title: 1-star review on an Airbnb welcome-book template (infleasy)
sources.text: Template could not be printed after personalizing and would not save. I lost hours of work.

problems.statement: Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.
problems.desired_outcome: Produce a house manual without tool failures.

sources.title: The ultimate Airbnb cleaning checklist (Touchstay)
sources.text: Guidance for hosts on standardizing turnover/cleaning so every cleaner follows the same steps.

problems.statement: Coordinating and standardizing cleaner turnover between guests is hard.

sources.title: Etsy 'airbnb welcome book template' — 1,000+ listings, many Bestsellers
sources.text: Large volume of host welcome-book / house-manual templates sold, indicating hosts seek help assembling what to include.
sources.retrieval_method: browser search results (2026-09-08); individual listings not all inspected

problems.statement: New hosts don't know what to include in a welcome book / house manual.
